create_base_dataset_subclass: create a subclass of BaseDataset that overrides get_train_instance and get_test_instance methods
read_jsonl_dataset: read a JSONL file into a PyTorch Dataset with optional max instance limit and tqdm progress
truncate_dataset_instances: truncate a BaseDataset to keep only the first N instances and return the rest
extend_dataset_instances: extend a BaseDataset with additional instance dictionaries from another source
create_ts_prompting_dataset: create a TSPromptingDataset subclass that overrides j2_prompt_args, promptify_example, and get_metadata
